### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 6/10" aria-label="Importance 6 of 10">6</span> SUNY ESF Joins NSF-Funded FIRE-NET Network for Regional Wildfire Resilience in Northern New York
The SUNY College of Environmental Science and Forestry (ESF) announced its participation in FIRE-NET: Adirondack Fire Futures, an NSF-supported network addressing wildfire resilience across northern New York. The project, led by Professor Andrew Vander Yacht's Applied Forest and Fire Ecology Lab, integrates 15+ years of research on fire as a driver of forest ecosystem resilience into regional fire preparedness and forest management planning.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>NSF Award #2536051 funds FIRE-NET: Adirondack Fire Futures network</li>
<li>SUNY ESF&#x27;s Applied Forest and Fire Ecology Lab (AFFEL) leads fire ecology research with 15+ years of disturbance ecology studies</li>
<li>Research portfolio includes fire effects on greenhouse gas emissions, forest hydrology, tick abundance, and fire-dependent biodiversity restoration</li>
<li>Network integrates ecological insights into Adirondack and North Country fire preparedness planning</li>
</ul>
